channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of tech opinions and blog posts curated for Yun Zhou

item.title: Nathan Lambert: Was I wrong about open models & cyber risks?
item.description: Lambert revisits his April claim that an open-weight Claude Mythos would have been 'fine' after 'Black October' — he still stands by it, but more nervously, and concedes a costly forced industry-wide software update is coming.

item.title: Andrew Ng: How to Face Your AI Fears This Year
item.description: Ng's annual Halloween letter: AI fears deserve a sober look, but fear-mongering is often a tactic for publicity and regulatory capture rather than a measured risk assessment.
